paite: Kuapeuh bawlhoihna it in theihna a-it hi; himahleh kuapeuh salhna hua ahai ahi.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

paite: Mihoih in TOUPA deihsakna atang ding; himahleh gitlouhna ngaihtuah mipa moh atangsak ding.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

paite: Gitlouhna in mi aphutkip kei ding; himahleh diktatna zung akisuan ngei kei ding.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

paite: Numei hoih apasal a ding in lallukhu ahi; himahleh zumhuai bawlnu aguhte ah muatna bang ahi.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

paite: Midiktat ngaihtuahna adik a; himahleh migilou thute khemna ahi.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

paite: Migilou thute sisan suah dia bukna ahi a; himahleh mitang kam in amau asuaktasak ding hi.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

paite: Migiloute zoh in a-om ua, a-om nawnta kei uh; himahleh midiktatte inn bel adingh ding hi.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

paite: Mihing apilna bangbang a phat in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang hoih lou muhsit in a-om ding hi.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

paite: Kuapeuh amah kingai thupi a, tanghou neiloumi sang in kuapeuh zahtak zek a om a sikha neimi ahoihzaw.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

paite: Midiktat in agan hinna alimsak hi, himahleh migilou zahngaihna nemte akhel mahmah hi.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

paite: Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding, himahleh mi bangmah lou nungdelhmi theihsiamna bei ahi.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

paite: Migilou in migiloute len adeih a, himahleh midiktatte zung in gah asuang hi.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

paite: Mukte tatlekna ah migilou a ding in thang a-om a, himahleh buaina a kipan midiktat ahong paikhe ding.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

paite: Amuk gah in mihoih tai in a-om ding a; huan mihing khut a hihte akiang a piak ahi ding.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

paite: Mihai lampi amah mit ah adik a; himahleh kuapeuh apil in thupha angaikhia hi.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

paite: Mihai buaina tu mahmah a theih ahi; himahleh mipilvang in zahlakna asel hi.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

paite: Kuapeuh thutak gen in diktatna a-ensak a, himahleh palai zuau in khemna.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

paite: Namsau sut bang a pilvang loutak a pau a-om a; himahleh mipil lei damna ahi.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

paite: Thutak lei tangtawn in hihkip in a-om ding; himahleh lei zuauthei zaw mitphiat kal khat a ding lel ahi.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

paite: Gilou thilgelte lungtang ah khemna a-om; himahleh lemna thupha gente kiang ah nopna a-om hi.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

paite: Midiktatte tung ah siatna ahong tung kei dia; himahleh migilou, gilou in adim ding.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

paite: Muk zuautheite TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh diktak a hihte akipahna ahi uh.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

paite: Mipilvang in theihna asel a; himahleh mihai lungtang in haina apuangkhia.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

paite: Mithanuam khut in vaihawmna apo dia; himahleh mithadah khut phutluih nna sepsak ahi ding hi.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

paite: Lungtang gikna in mi akunsak a; himahleh thuhoih in akipaksak hi.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

paite: Midiktat a-inveng a ding in pitu ahi a; himahleh migilou lampi in amaute a paikhialsak hi.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

paite: Mithadah in agamvakna a amatsa nangawn a-em ngap kei a; himahleh mithanuam vanneihte amanpha hi.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

paite: Diktatna lampi ah hinna a-om; huai alampi ah sihna a-om kei hi.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
